record.paper_title: Open Problems on Eigenvalues of the Laplacian
record.original_question: Among bounded domains Ω in ℝⁿ, what is the optimal upper bound for the Dirichlet eigenvalue ratio λ₃/λ₁, and which domain realizes that supremum, possibly only in a limiting sense? In particular, in dimension 2 the source asks for the exact value of sup_Ω λ₃/λ₁ and the optimizer, noting that the disk is not optimal.

evidence.quote: For Ω ⊂ ℝⁿ find the optimal bound on λ₃/λ₁ and the shape of domain that saturates it (possibly in a limiting sense). In ℝ² it is known that 35/11 ≈ 3.1818 ≤ sup_Ω λ₃/λ₁ ≤ 3.83103.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a bounded domain $\Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^n$, let $0<\lambda_1(\Omega)<\lambda_2(\Omega)\le\lambda_3(\Omega)\le\cdots$ denote the eigenvalues (counted with multiplicity) of the Dirichlet Laplacian, i.e. the values $\lambda$ for which there exists a nonzero $u\in H^1_0(\Omega)$ satisfying $-\Delta u=\lambda u$ in $\Omega$ and $u=0$ on $\partial\Omega$. Define
$$R_n \;=\; \sup_{\Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^n}\frac{\lambda_3(\Omega)}{\lambda_1(\Omega)},$$
where the supremum is taken over all bounded domains $\Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^n$.

(a) Determine $R_n$ explicitly for each $n\ge 2$, and identify a domain (or limiting sequence of domains) realizing this supremum.

(b) In particular, in dimension $n=2$, it is known that
$$\tfrac{35}{11}\;\approx\;3.1818\;\le\;R_2\;\le\;3.83103,$$
and that the disk does not realize $R_2$. Determine the exact value of $R_2$ and the extremal planar domain (possibly in a limiting sense).
artifact.status_search_result: The optimal upper bound for $\lambda_3/\lambda_1$ over bounded planar domains, and the identification of the extremal shape, appears to remain open. Known results provide only the bracketing $35/11 \le \sup_\Omega \lambda_3/\lambda_1 \le 3.83103$ in dimension 2, with the disk known not to be optimal; current literature on Dirichlet-Laplacian eigenvalue-ratio bounds continues to refine related estimates but does not give a sharp value.

status_evidence.title: More Bounds on Eigenvalue Ratios for Dirichlet Laplacians in N Dimensions
status_evidence.snippet: Work on isoperimetric bounds for eigenvalue ratios of the Dirichlet Laplacian, building on Payne–Pólya–Weinberger, Ashbaugh–Benguria, etc.
status_evidence.claim: Sharp bounds for higher eigenvalue ratios beyond λ₂/λ₁ are not established.

status_evidence.title: Minimization of Eigenvalues of the Dirichlet-Laplacian with a Diameter Constraint
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion showing the disk is not optimal for many eigenvalue functionals.
status_evidence.claim: Supports that the disk does not realize the supremum of λ₃/λ₁.
